dslRule:
<!id: filtered-preference-tree-expand-all-refactor>
<!description: Update call to FilteredPreferenceTree.setAllExpanded to pass null for the new start node parameter.>
<!severity: INFO>

$instance.setAllExpanded($expanded$) :: instanceof($instance, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.preferences.FilteredPreferenceTree")
=> $instance.setAllExpanded(null, $expanded$)
;;
summary: Updates calls to `FilteredPreferenceTree.setAllExpanded(boolean)` to `setAllExpanded(null, boolean)` due to method signature change within the `FilteredPreferenceTree` class hierarchy.
